newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti - Caio to meet investors next week.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti - Caio to meet investors next week.

text.p: Olivetti managing director Francesco Caio will meet investors and analysts in London on Monday and Tuesday next week, a company spokeswoman said.

Caio was in London on Monday to meet clients after the group's announcement last week that it made a 440.2 billion lire loss for the first half of this year and that chairman Carlo De Benedetti had resigned.

Olivetti shares fell 20 percent on the Milan bourse after a two-day suspension on Thursday and Friday, and hit a fresh record low at 575 lire on Tuesday morning before stabilising 0.55 percent down at 600 lire.
Bourse watchdog Consob late on Monday gave the group 24 hours to answer seven questions on the accounts, although it gave no details of the questions.
